R1 EVIDENCE-GATE OUTCOME (durable record) — verdict: LAND, do not escalate.

Zero-LLM re-score per ADR 0054, reproducible at docs/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py --residual=advisory|floor --root=<checkout>; method and audit in docs/calibration/plan_v5_kind_sets.md.

Corpus 22,667 plan findings carrying verification.severity_attributes. Baseline 2,897 findings at/above their block threshold. Because mapping historical prose to kinds is inexact, the 549 rule-unmatched dod rows are scored BOTH ways and the result reported as a bound, not a point estimate:
  - residual=advisory (pessimistic): new 2,885 — lost 47, gained 35
  - residual=floor   (optimistic):   new 2,946 — lost 15, gained 64

HAND AUDIT of all 15 losses surviving the optimistic bound: 3 are undecomposed bundling findings ('the plan bundles two independently-releasable outcomes') — precisely the class the 2026-08-10 operator decision designates advisory; the other 12 are dod findings whose complaint is 'does not specify / never names / does not enumerate / is procedurally rather than outcome framed' — the specificity class underspecified_certification exists to coach. NONE is a committed outcome without an oracle, and NONE is a broken or vacuous oracle. Zero unjustified losses, so the R1 escalation trigger is not met.

Gains (35-64) are findings whose recorded grade falls outside the old ordinal vocabulary, which _SEV01 maps to 0.0 — real defects that scored nothing and could not block. The closed kind set gives every member a defined consequence.

AC VERIFICATION against the LANDED tree (gerrit/main 8fe1115ea5, change 1635 MERGED): AC1 test_impact_plan -k literal passed; AC2 full test_impact_plan 25 passed; AC3 both rg commands exit 1 (hedge absent from src/rebar/, 'is present at any' absent from docs/plan-review-gate.md); AC4 sidecar+versioning 14 passed; AC5 both bounds reproduce the documented numbers and both artifacts are tracked under docs/calibration/. Gates: lint 0, typecheck 0 (502 files), 317 unit + 113 interface tests green.

AC checkboxes deliberately left unchecked: closed tickets in this repo keep '- [ ]' (verified on gopher/needlefish/rasbora), and det_floor._count_ac_items counts unchecked items, so flipping them to '- [x]' would zero the AC count P1 requires if the ticket were ever reopened.
